column5: FRAMING CORRECTION to our own 2026-04-01 WITHDRAWAL row, resolving the conflict PHAN logged-but-did-not-resolve on 2026-09-10. The CFPB WITHDREW ITS REQUEST that the court vacate Rule 1033 and instead REOPENED the rulemaking (ANPRM published 2025-08-22, comment period closed 2025-10-21; reconsideration covers "representative" definition, data-access FEES, data-security and data-privacy cost-benefit). The rule remains ENJOINED and the Apr-2026 compliance date is STAYED pending completion of the new rulemaking.
column6: The arc is RECONSIDERATION-AND-REWRITE, not agency self-vacatur. Outcome for phantom-debt visibility is the SAME (no 2026 enforcement, no visibility shock) but the MECHANISM differs: a rewritten rule can still arrive later, whereas a vacated rule could not. A rewrite that permits data-access FEES would additionally weaken any future visibility even once effective.
column8: P03 96%->97% (9/10) -> 98% — 2026 enforcement is now impossible on either reading, and the reopened-rulemaking path is SLOWER than vacatur would have been. ⚠️ Offsetting: "effectively dead" overstates it — a revived, fee-permissive 1033 is a live 2027+ branch that the DEAD framing would have hidden. §2b of DOSSIER.md carries the superseded "EFFECTIVELY DEAD" language VERBATIM by design (audit must-carry) — read it as an Apr-2026 artifact, not as status.
